titre: Ouvertures de cartes bancaires aux États-Unis
sous_titre: Variation sur un an en %, du deuxième trimestre 2025 au premier trimestre 2026

series.nom: Croissance sur un an des ouvertures de cartes bancaires

T2 2025.texte: increased for the third consecutive quarter, rising 9% YoY to 20.5 million in Q2 2025

T3 2025.texte: Bankcard originations rose 11.7% year-over-year in Q3 2025, marking the fourth consecutive quarterly increase

T4 2025.texte: Bankcard originations rose 13.0% year-over-year (YoY) to 21.9 million in Q4 2025

T1 2026.texte: Bankcard originations rose 11.8% YoY to 20.6 million, marking a sixth consecutive quarter of growth
